litigation.mdlName: In re: Paraquat Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of Illinois

phase: Settlement administration and selected opt-out proceedings
phaseDetail: The court continues to administer the confidential agreement for certain individual paraquat claims identified in CMO 24. June orders selected opt-out cases for limited discovery. A September 4 order sets a September 15, 2026 hearing concerning attorney Mark DiCello’s cases; this is a case-specific hearing, not a bellwether trial or a nationwide claim deadline.
defendants: Syngenta Crop Protection LLC / Syngenta AG

settlements.label: Confidential agreement for certain individual claims
settlements.detail: CMO 24 identifies a confidential Master Settlement Agreement executed September 3, 2025 for certain individual claims. The special master reviews qualification, eligibility and opt-out information. Public orders checked September 14, 2026 do not disclose a payout grid, settlement total or average individual award. A pending MDL action does not by itself establish settlement eligibility.

keyDates.label: MDL-3004 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal paraquat cases before Chief Judge Nancy J. Rosenstengel in the Southern District of Illinois.

keyDates.label: Master Settlement Agreement executed
keyDates.detail: Confidential agreement identified in Case Management Order No. 24, which describes the special master's settlement-administration responsibilities.

keyDates.label: Opt-out depositions ordered
keyDates.detail: The court ordered targeted depositions of opt-out plaintiffs at three firms amid reported high opt-out rates.

keyDates.label: Hearing concerning DiCello cases
keyDates.detail: September 4 order sets a 2 p.m. Central hearing. This is not a bellwether trial or general claim deadline.
